about: I Would Be So Happy shows Craig from South Park, in his blue hat with the yellow pom-pom, clutching a red book to his chest and gazing upward with a hopeful smile, while a confused Butters stands next to him in a school hallway under a "Go Cows!" sign. Craig is usually the most deadpan kid in the show, so seeing him dreamy and sincere is already funny. The meme borrows that wistful look for any small wish phrased as "if X, I would be so happy", whether genuinely longing or dripping with sarcasm.
origin: The image and line come from a South Park scene in which Craig earnestly describes what would make him happy. A YouTube clip titled "Craig - I would be so happy" is the usual source.
usage:
The top box is the wish, phrased as "if...". The bottom box completes it with "I would be so happy".

It works best when the wish is very specific and very small, so Craig's dreamy expression feels out of proportion: a meeting getting cancelled, a game finally getting a patch, a friend replying in under three hours. Sarcastic versions aimed at impossible wishes ("if my code worked the first time") are popular too.
ideas: if my code compiled on the first try
if the teacher forgot about the quiz
if they finally fixed the matchmaking
if my team made the playoffs once
aka: Craig I Would Be So Happy
